titulo: Live: Russia hits Kyiv’s Southern Bridge again as Moscow continues to pound capital
cuerpo: Russian drones on Friday hit Kyiv’s Southern Bridge for a fourth time in 24 hours, forcing authorities to close traffic on it. “They keep hitting it in the same place,” FRANCE 24’s Ukraine correspondent said, noting that it is one of Kyiv’s seven bridges and is extremely important to the life of the city. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments on the war in Ukraine.
